description: This PHP class 'Information' in the Opencart admin namespace manages the creation, listing, and clearing of information-related task files, including generating JSON data for informations and handling task registration.

classes.name: Information
classes.description: Controller class for handling information tasks in the Opencart admin panel, such as generating task lists and JSON representations of information entries.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Generates task list entries for information management, including clearing old tasks, listing current informations, and creating tasks for each information entry.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Generates and saves a JSON file containing information entries, including store data and descriptions.

methods.name: info
methods.description: Generates a JSON file for a specific information entry identified by its ID.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Removes the existing JSON information file from the server.
